author: RIPsycho
quote: Play Vice City or San Andreas if you want to experience a real GTA game. Not everyone likes being forced into a relationship or having to keep up with boring, brain-dead tasks like cleaning the house or running errands. I can't deny that the graphics are gorgeous, but story-wise, this feels like a step backward in GTA's evolution, and I am disappointed. This is on the game developers for failing to realize that we're here to escape reality and have fun. For now, I strongly don't recommend buying GTA VI.
